text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
That was seriously a great run! Congrats
on first
place!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I've accomplished my goal. I really...
truly did it!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I want to thank everyone for all your
support and
encouragement. I owe my
victory to all of you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Everyone in the Mejiro family, were you
watching
me as well?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I won! As a representative of the
Mejiros, I've
achieved my goal!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The entire time I was on the track, I
could see all
of your faces.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You helped lead me to victory! I thank
you! I
thank you from the bottom of my
heart!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro McQueen expresses her thanks to
her
family.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her gratitude encourages the crowd to
cheer on
with little sign of quieting
down.
